name: shark_pid
description: Embedded 2-DOF PID controller whose C99 core is a faithful reimplementation of the Simulink PID Controller (2DOF) block: every parameter maps 1:1 to a Block Parameters field, and the two match to numerical noise even when the output saturates. Explicit dt in every term, setpoint weighting (b, c), filter coefficient N, clamping and back-calculation anti-windup, NaN rejection and bumpless transfer. No Arduino or HAL dependency.
